long_biography.plain_text:
Trematore began his contracting business in 1984 with a desk in a hallway. The following year, its office moved into a house basement, and two years later into a small Clifton warehouse. He built the company around large-scale plumbing, pipefitting, heating and mechanical work while serving as its sole owner and president.

Now based in Fairfield, Brian Trematore Plumbing & Heating combines field crews with design-build, CAD and building-information modelling capabilities. Its projects extend along the East Coast and include schools, public facilities and complex commercial construction. Trematore’s command of mechanical systems and hands-on leadership shaped its growth. He remains the company’s founder, president and chief executive.
